name: Flat White
flavor_notes: A smooth and velvety hot coffee drink characterized by finely frothed milk that enhances the coffee's bold and intense aromas.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: Warm the milk to about 140°F (60°C) and froth it.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug with 5 oz hot water.
Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the foam on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Brew the Altissio coffee capsule directly into your mug.
Steam 3 oz of milk until finely frothed for a latte.
Slowly pour the steamed milk over the coffee.
Finish by spooning a small amount of microfoam on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: Warm the milk to about 140°F (60°C) and froth it.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 5 oz (150 ml) hot water directly in the mug.
Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the foam on top.
